verses.1: Praise ye the LORD. Sing to the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
verses.2: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.3: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises to him with the timbrel and harp:
verses.4: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.5: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.6: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a two-edged sword in their hand;
verses.7: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
verses.8: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.9: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honor have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.

metadata.source: Derived from Webster's Bible (1833), revised as a poetic KJV-tradition translation filtered through the theology of abiding in Christ.
